scope: Only the successful replacement-undivided-holder round; no hardware, camera, ROS execution, video decoding or transcoding during this metrics review

ros_task_commands.definition: Unique logged ROS task command_intent records in old controller sequence41..53 and new controller sequence1..36; not model API calls, not total tool calls, not CAN-frame count
ros_task_commands.requested_grouping: 13 home + 34 post-home arm motions + 2 independent jaw commands
ros_task_commands.post_home_motion_detail: 1 joint preparation +33 pose commands; home includes12 pose commands+1 six-zero joint command

speed_percent_review.scope: Controller-requested percentage for arm commands; not measured Cartesian speed and not video playback multiplier
speed_percent_review.range_description: Old home sequence41–49 used50%; new controller sequence2–9 and19–25 used50%. Final six-zero old53 used1%; later alignment/descents/retreat used3%, with5/10/20% transition steps. Jaw event speed_percent=3 is a context field and is not an arm motion or a calibrated jaw speed.

intent_to_observed_stable_latency.definition: Timestamp(command_observed_stable) minus timestamp(command_intent), paired by controller-log identity and command sequence
intent_to_observed_stable_latency.scope_note: Includes ROS dispatch, feedback acquisition and stability observation; excludes gaps between commands, model/site waiting, and old home53 with no stable event. A stable log is not itself a grasp/placement proof.

recording_timing.interpretation: Recording wall time includes setup/teardown outside frame samples. Actual frame host intervals differ slightly from nominal15fps; MP4 duration is frame_count/15. Full exports retain every common frame; the front source has one additional tail frame. The 6.447s difference is not evidence of deleted interior waiting or physical speedup.
